jira.description:
# Initial request

* Consider using a tab system to allow administrators to configure different categories (Delegate, Exhibitor, Moderator, etc.) This will make it easier to manage a large number of categories.
* The user interface should provide a clear indication of the default settings (all categories will have networking options switched on by default).
* The system should allow administrators to easily switch between ‘Save Changes’ and individual category configuration. ‘Save Changes’ should apply the configuration for that specific tab only.

# Tech brief

Need to rework the “Manage Permissions“ page in the admin panel at /admin/permissionRelations.

### Design

<custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-0">https://www.figma.com/design/MHjUtJtDXZSpSQi4FDw8eI/Admin-Panel---New-UI?node-id=44344-96720</custom> – Design  
<custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-1">https://www.figma.com/design/MHjUtJtDXZSpSQi4FDw8eI/Admin-Panel---New-UI?node-id=47528-25084&t=2K3DttEeqKOBblqV-4</custom> – Adaptation

## Manage permissions page

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=e2af65b8-c1ab-4ad5-9030-a9ac7aa98ce3&&collection=&height=1536&occurrenceKey=null&width=2702&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
Need to rework the “Manage permissions“ page in the admin panel at /admin/permissionRelations.

### Page description

This block displays is the upper part of the page container.

**Title:** Manage Permissions  
**Description:** On this page, you can configure permissions for different categories and roles. Select a category from the left column to adjust its settings. Use the toggles to enable or disable actions for the selected category relative to other categories.

### Troubleshooting info block

Can be opened using the button in the top right corner of the page container. 

On the button hover, a tooltip “Troubleshooting“ appears.

On the button click, the button should disapear and a block with the text advices should appear:

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=bca621de-f895-4cf4-a0e2-4de5fcb16111&&collection=&height=300&occurrenceKey=null&width=1248&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
### Left sidebar

In the Left sidebar there is a Search field and list of user categories and roles. 

#### Roles and categories

All they are divided in groups:

* Participant categories – contains all participant categories including Default category, listed in the same order as on the categories management page.
* Exhibitor categories – contains all exhibitor categories including Default category, listed in the same order as on the categories management page.
* Roles – Contain Speaker, Moderator, Team Member, Buyer.
* Other – For now contains only “Guest“

Each item should work as a tab. Switch between these items leads to scroll of the content in the manage block (main container).

When scrolling this block, the search bar and category section title (Participant Categories, Exhibitor Categories, Roles, Other) should be sticky to the scroll (applicable for new admin only).

#### Actions

On the item hover, the three-dots menu button should appear. On click, a dropdown menu with options of the bulk actions appear. Picking of any option will cause a bulk change of respective permissions. To apply them need to make approval in the pop-up. After action is performed, the menu item changes to oposite (Block → Allow or Allow → Block).

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=b51a9af2-b79e-45c0-87b5-16da45e2c925&&collection=&height=423&occurrenceKey=null&width=1444&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
#### Search

Search by category and role names. 

Search should be applied after input of any character with the standard debounce.

Search results are shown….. to be added after design specifies this.

When no results found, the respective placeholder will be shown.

### Manage block (Main container)

Upper part of this block contains title and text description:

**Title:** `Category or Role name, depends on an active tab`  
**Description:** On this page, you can configure what actions are allowed or disallowed for the chosen category

When the active tab belongs to a Roles (Speaker, Moderator, Team Member, Buyer) an additional message will be displayed:  
"To ensure that permissions function properly for different roles, please also configure the associated categories. Please note that a role permission supersedes a category permission."

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=b20ffa53-6666-4fbb-aafd-0f43ee239ca1&&collection=&height=405&occurrenceKey=null&width=864&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
Below this, there is a table with categories and roles, and toggles that allow to control permissions: Initiate meetings, Send messages, View profile.

After any toggle in the Manage block is being switched on/off,  changes should be applied (no save button) and the success message should appear.

When scrolling the Manage block, the table header should be sticky to the scroll so that it remains visible until all content is scrolled through, ensuring that the actions labeled in the header are visible (applicable for new admin only).

### The logic

In left sidebar user picks whose permissions to be managed.   
In main containter user manages permissions.

When the “Initiate Meetings“ toggle is disabled for the category, this means that user of selected in the sidebar category can’t initiate meetings with the category.  
When the “Send Message“ toggle is disabled for the category, this means that user of selected in the sidebar category can’t initiate chats with the category. They can chat in existing chats.  
When the “View Profile“ toggle is disabled for the category, this means that user of selected in the sidebar category can’t see cards of users of the category and can’t visit their profiles. 

If a permission is allowed for at least one of the user’s roles or categories then it will be allowed for all of them.

After deploy all setting on the prod should remain.
